description: Resolve a selected capability's project context, requested outcome, safe target, and applicable invocation mode before dependent work. Common authority judgment remains with the existing authorization behavior.
inputs: Selected capability and requested outcome, subject, scope, and target context.
Applicable project instructions, supplied evidence, current governed signals, and available authorization basis.
outputs: Bounded invocation context with portable or governed obligations and required prerequisites.
Explicit unresolved context, authority, or target boundary when preparation cannot complete.
behavior: Use applicable project-local or supplied context without requiring RigorLoop internal repository documents for portable work.
Identify a safe authorized target or report ambiguity; establish actual scope and inputs before a dependent action.
Distinguish portable operation from governed or durable recording triggers under the selected specialist contract, including malformed signals and late triggers.
Use the common authority result for reserved actions and preserve valid existing grants within their limits.
Reclassify before newly dependent work when scope, authority, or recording conditions materially change.

Bind the invocation to applicable project instructions and authority. When an adopted workflow governs the requested work, identify its selected contract and separate isolated scope from authorized continuation. Otherwise sufficient authorized portable work requires no RigorLoop workflow adoption, internal records or CLI. A project-selected document-based exception is attributable authority, not a fallback inferred from failed governed discovery.

failure_behavior.condition: A required target, project policy, or governed signal is missing, conflicting, or ambiguous.
failure_behavior.outcome: Stop the dependent action with the exact unresolved boundary; do not silently downgrade to portable writes.
